name: Electric nail drill (e-file) manicure videos
what_it_is: Close-up clips of nail technicians using electric rotary nail drills (e-files) with metal bits and sanding discs to file, buff and remove gel/acrylic from nails, plus one review of the O'Nail drill. Posted across September 2026, the videos share the same tool and filing activity rather than reacting to a single event.
